dashboard.communitySearch.empty: Shown in a community search when nothing matches what was typed.
dashboard.communitySearch.placeholder: Placeholder of the site operator's search for a community to open in the dashboard.
dashboard.communitySearch.searching: Shown in a community search while results load.
dashboard.communitySearch.trigger: Button at the end of the dashboard's community tabs: opens a search for any other community (site operators).
dashboard.error.body: First paragraph of the dashboard error.
dashboard.error.home: Link back to the dashboard's first page.
dashboard.error.retry: Second paragraph of the dashboard error; a reference code is shown below it.
dashboard.error.title: Title shown when a dashboard panel fails to load.
dashboard.masthead.community: Eyebrow over a community dashboard's heading.
dashboard.masthead.communityPage: Link from a community's dashboard to its public page.
dashboard.masthead.site: Eyebrow over the site-wide dashboard's heading.
dashboard.nav.community.board: Community dashboard panel: how the community's rating board ranks.
dashboard.nav.community.challonge: Community dashboard panel for the Challonge account. Product name; usually left as is.
dashboard.nav.community.claims: Community dashboard panel: requests to claim a player profile.
dashboard.nav.community.identity: Community dashboard panel: the community's description, logo and link.
dashboard.nav.community.import: Community dashboard panel: importing tournaments from other platforms.
dashboard.nav.community.inclusions: Community dashboard panel: other communities and events this one's board takes in.
dashboard.nav.community.moderators: Community dashboard panel: the community's staff.
dashboard.nav.community.parrygg: Community dashboard panel for the parry.gg account. Product name; usually left as is.
dashboard.nav.community.players: Community dashboard panel: everyone who has entered one of the community's events.
dashboard.nav.community.provisional: Community dashboard panel: walk-up players not yet matched to a profile.
dashboard.nav.community.seasons: Community dashboard panel: the community's ranking seasons.
dashboard.nav.community.series: Community dashboard panel: recurring event series.
dashboard.nav.community.startgg: Community dashboard panel for the start.gg account. Product name; usually left as is.
dashboard.nav.group.content: Site dashboard rail group: events, series, imports.
dashboard.nav.group.curation: Dashboard rail group: what counts on a community's board (inclusions, seasons, board settings).
dashboard.nav.group.overview: Dashboard rail group holding the overview panels.
dashboard.nav.group.people: Dashboard rail group: players, claims, staff.
dashboard.nav.group.programming: Dashboard rail group: what a community runs (events, series, imports).
dashboard.nav.group.system: Dashboard rail group: settings and accounts on other platforms.
dashboard.nav.site.challongeDirectory: Site dashboard panel. Challonge is a product name.
dashboard.nav.site.claims: Site dashboard panel: requests to claim a player profile.
dashboard.nav.site.features: Site dashboard panel: the site's on/off switches.
dashboard.nav.site.import: Site dashboard panel: importing tournaments from other platforms.
dashboard.nav.site.provisional: Site dashboard panel: walk-up players not yet matched to a profile.
dashboard.nav.site.ratings: Site dashboard panel: the rating engine.
dashboard.nav.site.retention: Site dashboard panel: what the site deletes once it is past its retention period, and when each rule last ran.
dashboard.nav.site.series: Site dashboard panel: recurring event series.
dashboard.nav.title: The management console's name: its rail heading and its page title.
dashboard.overview.games.entrants: Under the total in the middle of the games chart.
dashboard.overview.games.entrantsInBrack: Caption under a game in the dashboard's games chart; {entrants} is an already-formatted count of entrants, {n} how many brackets they played in.
dashboard.overview.games.ofEntrants: Games chart tooltip, after a percentage: that game's share of all entrants.
dashboard.overview.games.series: Name of the series in the dashboard's games chart.
dashboard.overview.roster.series: Name of the one series in the dashboard's roster chart.
dashboard.overview.roster.window: Roster chart tooltip, under the player count: the trailing window the count covers. The bold part is drawn as a figure.
dashboard.unrankedImports.awaiting: Heading of the warning listing community imports waiting for an operator to decide whether they count; {n} is how many.
dashboard.unrankedImports.completedSets: On an imported tournament awaiting a ranked decision: how many of its sets finished.
dashboard.unrankedImports.excluded: Heading of the same warning for a reader who cannot decide, counting tournaments left out of ratings; {n} is how many.
dashboard.unrankedImports.keepUnranked: Button leaving an imported tournament out of ratings.
dashboard.unrankedImports.rank: Button counting an imported tournament towards ratings.
dashboard.unrankedImports.ranking: The rank button while it runs.
